fields.label: Mail service
fields.description: Gmail and Microsoft 365 — SMTP/IMAP servers and ports are filled in automatically. Choose «Other» to enter the settings manually.

fields.label: Email address
fields.description: Full email address. For Gmail it is also used as the SMTP login.

fields.label: Sign-in
fields.description: Password — an app password (Gmail) or the mailbox password. OAuth — sign in through Google or Microsoft without a password; needed for Microsoft 365, where password sign-in is turned off.

fields.label: Connected app
fields.description: The OAuth app of your Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 through which the mailbox is connected (Integrations → Connected apps).

fields.label: Connected account
fields.description: The account that allowed access. Sign in as the owner of the mailbox.

fields.label: Connect account
fields.description: Save the account first. A Google or Microsoft page opens: sign in to the mailbox and allow access.

fields.label: Open the Google app passwords page
fields.description:
To send email through Gmail you need an «app password», not the regular account password.

1. Open your Google account → «Security» and turn on «2-Step Verification» (app passwords are unavailable without it).
2. Click the button above or open https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords
3. Enter an app name (e.g. «Grunt») and click «Create».
4. Copy the 16-character code into the «SMTP password» field below — spaces can stay, they are removed automatically.

fields.label: SMTP user
fields.description: SMTP login. Usually the same as the email address; filled in automatically for Gmail.

fields.label: SMTP password (app password)
fields.description:
For Gmail — a 16-character app password (App Password). The regular Google account password does not work.
A saved password is not shown again — to change it, enter a new one.

fields.label: Test connection (SMTP)
fields.description: Checks the connection and sign-in to the SMTP server without sending an email.

fields.label: Send test email
fields.description: Sends a short test email to the given address through this account. Save your changes first.

fields.label: Enable outgoing mail
fields.description: Allows this account to send emails.

fields.label: SMTP server
fields.description: For Gmail: smtp.gmail.com — filled in automatically.

fields.label: SMTP port
fields.description: Gmail: 587 (STARTTLS).

fields.label: Enable incoming mail
fields.description: Reads incoming emails over IMAP. Not needed just for sending. Gmail requires the same app password.

fields.label: IMAP folders
fields.description: Comma-separated. New letters are read without marking them as read in the mailbox

fields.label: IMAP position
fields.description: The last letter read in each folder (UIDVALIDITY + UID)

fields.label: Incoming letters → documents
fields.description: A reply to a letter sent from a document lands on that document. A new letter creates a document of the chosen type

fields.label: Create documents
fields.description: Only document types with “Create from incoming mail” on

fields.label: Auto-reply
fields.description: Answer each letter that created a document. Not sent to robots, mailing lists or no-reply addresses

fields.label: Auto-reply text
fields.description: Placeholders: {name} - the document, {subject} - the letter's subject, {sender} - its address

fields.label: Notify if not answered
fields.description: When the last letter on a document has had no reply from it for the set time: the document's assignees, or the group when nobody is assigned

fields.label: Signature
fields.description: Added to letters written from documents and to auto-replies

fields.label: Reply-To
fields.description: Where replies should go, when not to this mailbox

fields.label: Always BCC
fields.description: Every letter from this mailbox also goes, hidden, to this address (an archive)
